# Composed pages

Pages of your own, built from blocks in a JSX layout.

- [Composed pages](../reference/layouts.md#setup): Pages built from a JSX layout, with their own address, sidebar entry and role limits, reading the API under the same access rules as the lists.
- [Layout checks](../reference/layouts.md#what-a-layout-may-hold): The build refuses a layout with code, unknown props or unknown fields, and names the file and place.
- [Conditions](../reference/layouts.md#conditions): Part of a page shows only while a condition on a record or a count holds.
- [App addresses](../reference/layouts.md#addresses): Links to lists, records, create forms and pages are typed addresses that can carry filters and prefilled values.
- [Per-user pages](../reference/layouts.md#access): Each user gets the page without the parts, fields and actions they cannot use.
- [Layout blocks](../reference/blocks.md#layout): Pages, responsive grids, cards and links.
- [Data blocks](../reference/blocks.md#data): Counts, tables, single records, rows of cards, field values and progress bars.
- [Record rows](../reference/blocks.md#recordrow): A sideways row of cards for a filter, favorites or saved searches, with a count and new-record marks.
- [Record cards](../reference/blocks.md#recordcards): Full-width cards with fields and buttons, stacked or in a carousel.
- [Chart block](../reference/blocks.md#chart): Counts, sums or averages by value or by date, as bars, lines or a donut, and over time split by a second field.
- [Buttons and forms](../reference/blocks.md#behaviour): Buttons for named actions, and create or edit forms in a dialog.
- [Settings block](../reference/blocks.md#settings): Each person's own settings from a resource with one record per person, saved as they change, with defaults until the first save.
- [Users block](../reference/blocks.md#users): User management on any page: find users, set roles, block them and invite by email.
